summary: Executed backend + frontend auth regression on Preview for login hardening, temp password rollout (010101), trusted-device fallback, and role/session integrity.

critical.issue: Credentialed CORS contract still broken on public preview response: Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials missing, while auth relies on httpOnly cookies.

action_items: Fix live preview edge/proxy CORS behavior for auth endpoints to return explicit origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true when cookies are used.
Re-run auth regression after CORS fix to confirm cross-origin cookie flows remain stable.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth login hardening behaves fail-closed for name-only and retired old PIN (401 as expected).
Password login returns pin_configured=false for both مدير and احمد, matching temporary-password rollout intent.
No working-tree changes detected for /app/backend/core/accounting_engine.py or /app/backend/routes_finance.py in this test run.

success_rate.backend: 87.5% (7/8 assertions passed, 1 failed; 1 additional test skipped due missing MONGO_URL/DB_NAME in pytest env)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (requested auth UI flows passed in targeted run)

context_for_next_testing_agent: UI checks passed: /login starts in password mode without trusted_device, empty submit shows login-error-alert + visible toast, manager/accountant password login both redirect and /api/auth/me roles are correct, stale trusted_device + old PIN forces fallback to password mode and clears trusted_device. Backend blocker remains public CORS credential header mismatch.
rca of the issue: Repro: POST https://financial-ssot.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login with Origin=https://financial-ssot.preview.emergentagent.com and valid credentials returns 200 + Set-Cookie, but response headers contain ACAO='*' and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. Root cause is likely ingress/edge CORS override, not the core login handler logic. Mitigation: enforce explicit allowed origins and credentials headers at the outer proxy layer for /api/auth/* responses.
